name: tracehub-mcp
description: MCP server for querying OpenTelemetry traces across multiple observability backends (Jaeger, Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, and AWS X-Ray) for LLM application debugging
long_description:
TraceHub MCP lets AI agents query and analyze OpenTelemetry traces from LLM applications. It parses gen_ai.* / llm.* semantic-convention attributes to enable automated debugging, cost analysis, and observability across Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, and AWS X-Ray backends.

This bundle does not vendor the server's source: it declares the published `tracehub-mcp` PyPI package as a dependency in a bundled pyproject.toml and runs it via `uv run`, which resolves and installs the real package from PyPI at launch time.

author.name: Doron Kopit, Gal Klienman, Nir Gazit, sairam0424

backend_type.title: Backend Type
backend_type.description: Observability backend to query. One of: jaeger, tempo, traceloop, datadog, sentry, xray.

backend_url.title: Backend URL
backend_url.description: Backend API endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:16686 for Jaeger, http://localhost:3200 for Tempo, https://api.traceloop.com/v2 for Traceloop, https://api.datadoghq.com for Datadog, https://sentry.io for Sentry, or https://xray.<region>.amazonaws.com for X-Ray (decorative only for X-Ray - never dereferenced for a live request).

backend_api_key.title: Backend API Key
backend_api_key.description: Authentication key for the backend. Required for Traceloop and Datadog; for Sentry this must be an auth token with trace/event read permissions. Not needed for a local/self-hosted Jaeger or Tempo, or for X-Ray (which authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain).

backend_aws_region.title: AWS Region
backend_aws_region.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required only when Backend Type is xray.

backend_app_key.title: Backend App Key
backend_app_key.description: Datadog application key, used together with Backend API Key. Required only when Backend Type is datadog.

backend_tempo_instance_id.title: Tempo Instance ID (Grafana Cloud)
backend_tempo_instance_id.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used together with Backend API Key (a Cloud Access Policy token) for Basic Auth. Required only for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo; not needed for self-hosted Tempo.

backend_sentry_org.title: Sentry Organization Slug
backend_sentry_org.description: Sentry organization slug. Required only when Backend Type is sentry, since every Sentry API endpoint this backend uses is organization-scoped.

backend_sentry_project.title: Sentry Project Slug
backend_sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug to narrow queries to. Optional; when omitted, queries span every project the auth token can access. Only used when Backend Type is sentry.

backend_environments.title: Traceloop Environments
backend_environments.description: Comma-separated list of environments. Only used when Backend Type is traceloop.

backend_timeout.title: Backend Request Timeout (seconds)
backend_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for calls to the backend.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging level. One of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

max_traces_per_query.title: Max Traces Per Query
max_traces_per_query.description: Maximum number of traces parsed per query.
